description: Baseline UAV registration requirement. All civilian drones operated in Nepal must carry a valid CAAN registration certificate.
requiredPermits: CAAN Drone Registration Certificate (Unique Identification Number)

description: Check operator nationality. Foreign pilots require MoHA screening and Department of Tourism approval.
requiredPermits: Ministry of Home Affairs Security Clearance Letter

description: Check operation purpose. Commercial mapping/filming requires a CAAN Flight Operations Permit.
Check if recreational flight is higher-altitude or heavier, which routing procedures direct to DAO approval.
requiredPermits: Local District Administration Office (DAO) Flight Clearance

description: Check if flight occurs inside a national park boundary.
requiredPermits: Department of National Parks and Wildlife Conservation (DNPWC) Flight Approval

description: Check if flight occurs over a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
requiredPermits: Department of Archaeology (DoA) Ancient Monument Photography Clearance
